name: mesa
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native Android design for RachaConta, an app for Brazilian university friends splitting a restaurant or boteco bill equally. Show ONE coherent design named Mesa de amigos through TWO complete app screens side by side, each with a 390 x 844 logical viewport; total board approximately 804 x 844 with a narrow neutral gutter. App content edge to edge, crisp Portuguese text, no device bodies, bezels, OS status bars, notches or external presentation labels.

The left screen is a welcoming amount-led form. Reading order: RachaConta wordmark; “Bora rachar?”; “Valor da conta” with editable “R$ 100,00”; “Pessoas” with familiar minus, 3, plus controls; “Serviço opcional” with Android switch visibly OFF and “10%” shown inactive; helper “Só se ainda não estiver na conta.”; optional “Nome do encontro” containing “Pizza de sexta”; primary “Calcular divisão”; secondary “Usar exemplo”.

The right screen has a back arrow and “Resultado”; encounter “Pizza de sexta”; lead “Divisão por pessoa”; clearly distinct rows “2 pessoas · R$ 33,33” and “1 pessoa · R$ 33,34”; helper “Os centavos fecham o total.”; concise breakdown “Conta R$ 100,00”, “Serviço R$ 0,00”, “Total R$ 100,00”; switch OFF “Incluir serviço de 10%”; “Editar conta”.

Style: warm butter and cream base with terracotta primary actions, bottle-green typography accents, and a small hand-painted Brazilian neighborhood sign voice only in the wordmark. Friendly contemporary sans for labels and crisp numbers. Open breathing room and a very restrained geometric shared-table motif create friendship without photos or alcohol imagery. Use familiar native Android controls, 48dp touch targets, 14–16sp body text, strong contrast. No nested cards, extra features, flags or carnival clichés.
